title: Trellis product graph
description: Authored OUTSIDE Trellis and handed in complete. This is the boundary between two systems that cannot see each other, so the validator is deliberately unforgiving.

invariants.description: True of every node. Restated into node notes at slice time.

non_goals.description: Explicitly out of scope for both versions. Prevents scope drift during slicing.

definition.description: What this version must do standing alone. v1 must be shippable even if v2 is never built.

scale_target.description: Concurrent users this version must hold. Drives which scale-tier reference loads.

id.description: Stable slug, dotted namespaces encouraged (auth.session, data.user-model).

version.description: Which release this belongs to as authored. `trellis promote` may suggest moving v2 nodes up; it never moves them automatically.

kind.description: interface = a contract two or more other nodes consume. These are the integration-break nodes.

deps.description: Ids of nodes that must exist first. A v1 node depending on a v2 node is a hard validation failure.

acceptance.description: What done means, in plain language, one bullet per checkable claim. Becomes the seed for the cases session.

reversibility.description: one-way = changing your mind later costs a migration or a breaking change. Data models, auth, multitenancy, public API shape, billing.

surfaces.description: What this node touches that can hurt you. Non-empty (other than 'none') forces the security lens and derives high risk.

scale_tier.description: The user count at which this node must still hold. Usually the version's scale_target; raise it for nodes that are expensive to revisit.

lenses.description: Which references/chiefs and references/skills entries load as Layer 3 when this node is planned.

high_risk.description: DERIVED. Do not author this field; the validator computes it and rejects graphs that set it. True when risk_level is high.

risk_level.description: DERIVED. Do not author. high = one-way door, consequential surface (auth/payments/secrets), or two or more dependents. audit = pii/network/filesystem only. Reviewed at triage accordingly.
